say:3:1120310001:1.text: My business is all taken care of now. Sorry for the wait. If everyone's ready to leave, we can go at any time.
say:3:1120310001:1.source_cn: 久等了各位，我的事情已经交代好了。如果你们方便的话，我...

say:4:1120310002:1.text: The quicker we get there, the sooner this boy can start on the road to recovery, and everyone can put their minds at ease much earlier.
say:4:1120310002:1.source_cn: 早一点到达，那孩子的病情就可以早一点好转，你们也能早点...

say:5:1120310003:1.text: Every moment spent worrying about that child's health is agonizing for all of you, I'm sure.
say:5:1120310003:1.source_cn: 为孩子的安危提心吊胆的日子，可真不好过啊。

say:6:1120310004:1.text: I'm not sure I could ever thank you enough for this, Smokey...
say:6:1120310004:1.source_cn: 太好了！我简直不知道该怎么谢你才好……

say:7:1120310005:1.text: But if you manage to heal that boy, then, on behalf of the entire Uru Clan, Alsa and I swear we'll repay you in kind for your help.
say:7:1120310005:1.source_cn: 如果你真能治好那孩子，我和阿尔萨代表乌尔氏族向你承诺，...

say:8:1120310006:1.text: Oh come now, that won't be necessary! After all, the child's safety is what matters most right now...
say:8:1120310006:1.source_cn: 啊呀，好说好说！我帮你们，可不是为了酬劳，主要还是为了...

say:9:1120310007:1.text: But if you insist, I'll gladly accept any payment you and your companions are willing to offer!
say:9:1120310007:1.source_cn: 不过既然你们非要给，我也不会不收！到时候的酬劳就拜托各...
